newsitem.title: UK: LME base metals little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME base metals little changed in late trading.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) base metal prices failed to stray far from afternoon kerb closes in late trading on Thursday amid light volumes, traders said.
Flagship three months copper was quoted just lower at $2,582/2,585 at 1800 GMT, after finishing the afternoon kerb at $2,585.50.
Zinc at $1,393/1,395 was also barely different from its strong kerb close following the day's early rally to fresh 4-3/4 year highs.
Nickel remained near the day's lows at $7,155/7,165, compared to $7,160, as the market watched for developments on news that talks are to resume at strike-bound Inco facilities.
Aluminium was also stable at $1,584/1,585, versus $1,584.
